human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Aggregate GovernanceSignals by deterministic signal type/subject over a time window and provide affected run IDs, first/last seen, occurrence count, severity distribution, and trend buckets. This is observed problem discovery, not causal AI diagnosis. Dependency: 8019.add-fleet-overview.
human_pressure.why_now: Problem Discovery is the bridge from visibility to deciding which runtime governance capability deserves implementation next.
do_not_misread: This pack is intentionally narrow; do not absorb later packs into it.
Evidence is authoritative; derived state must remain reconstructable from evidence.
red_lines: Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.

machine_core.goal: Implement evidence-backed cross-run problem groups and drill-down data.
red_lines: Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
invariants: Depends on: 8019.add-fleet-overview. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
Problem group is an aggregate view.
contracts: Aggregate -> runs -> signal evidence drill-down is preserved.
failure_semantics: No signal means no observed problem group; it does not mean system is proven healthy.

steps.title: Define ProblemGroup DTO
details: signal_type, subject key, count, affected_run_ids, first_seen, last_seen, severity counts, trend buckets.

steps.title: Support drill-down
details: Problem detail returns contributing signals/evidence refs.
Do not copy raw artifact bodies.

acceptance: Problem groups derive only from persisted GovernanceSignals.
Each group can return affected run IDs and evidence-linked contributing signals.
validate: python -m ruff check src/ailuros/problems.py src/ailuros/storage/sqlite_storage.py tests/test_problem_aggregation.py

must_check: Problem aggregation is signal-based and evidence-drillable.
reject_if: Problem text claims root cause without explicit evidence.
Raw logs are grouped by fuzzy text heuristics as governance facts.
Unknown or missing evidence is treated as passed.
